 Social Security EXCLUSIVE: Social Security Administration Provides Valuable Updates on Issues Affecting Seniors 
 Social Security corrected tens of millions of files in its Social Security Number database, and the November package also explains how to spot a government impostor calling you.
 By Gerry Hafer - AMAC Foundation · November 9, 2026 · 1 min read 
 Listen · 1 min AMAC Radio Comments Print Share Save AMAC’s partnership with the Social Security Administration gives us access to the agency’s Monthly Information Package (MIP), a collection of articles that provides updates on Social Security programs, services, and resources. In support of the AMAC Foundation’s mission to serve as a trusted educational resource for older Americans, we value this opportunity to bring more internal SSA information directly to the people we serve.
 The November package includes:
 Social Security’s Digital-First Strategy Produces Best Performance In Agency History 
 Social Security Corrects Tens Of Millions Of Files In The Social Security Number Database Improving The Integrity Of Vital Records 
 If You Need A Replacement Social Security Card, Apply Online 
 Go Digital! Quickly And Securely Update Your Direct Deposit Data Online 
 Is That A Call From The Government—Or A Scammer? 
 For past issues, visit  ssa.gov/news/en/mip .
 Look for updated compilations in AMAC media every month and, if you have any questions or need any further detail on the topics covered, our acclaimed AMAC Foundation  Social Security Advisory Service  is available to help you.
